# Klasker AITA

> Klasker AITA (Artificial Intelligence Trade Analysis) is an analytical platform for evaluating websites, products and services in the emerging world of Agentic AI.

Important notes:

- Klasker evaluates digital trade readiness, machine-facing information, accessibility to AI agents and Agentic AI readiness.
- Public evaluations are made available through the Klasker Observatory.
- Premium evaluations may remain private.
- Klasker is developed and maintained by OSTARA.WORK, a micro-enterprise founded in France.
- Klasker prioritises privacy, accessibility, static content, clear information and minimal dependencies.
- The public Klasker website is generated using Grad SSG and deployed on Cloudflare Pages.

## Website

- [Klasker AITA Homepage](https://www.klasker.com/): Official Klasker AITA website.
- [Public Observatory](https://www.klasker.com/observatory/): Publicly available Klasker evaluations.
- [Compare](https://www.klasker.com/compare/): Comparison of publicly available Klasker evaluations.
- [Blog](https://www.klasker.com/blog/): Klasker articles and research.

- [OSTARA.WORK](https://www.ostara.work/): Official website of OSTARA.WORK, the micro-enterprise developing and maintaining Klasker AITA.

## Development

- [Grad SSG](https://github.com/OSTARA711/grad): Static website generator written with Bun "hot reload" and used by OSTARA.WORK website.
- [Klasker WROS](https://www.klasker.com/): Workspaces Research Operating System.
- [Klasker OGMA](https://github.com/OSTARA711/klasker-ogma): Offline Guidance, Monitoring and Analysis.
